title: Bound finite monomial decoder stock on #7244 (0% κ change)
body:
## Result

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. The κ change is exactly 0%.** Exact [#7244](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7244) remains the strongest independently reproduced comparable result at κ = 0.003645372367832. This package proves zero paid savings in a scoped one-input, one-retained-child decoder, even with any fixed finite number of ordinary monomial terms on its source and returned fields.

The full native census has 6,281 MOVEs and 2,602 ordered retained/omitted pairs. For 1,516 pairs the source, retained output, and requested output lie in three distinct chart cosets. The inherited all-column tensor lift makes their normalized row overlaps decay. The exact Gram bound excludes every fixed finite arm count as column multiplicity grows. The remaining 1,086 pairs reduce to a monomial source bypass. Every apparent source depends on the MOVE it would remove. No ordered pair remains unresolved. The whole 17-stage saving is zero and the raw target margin is at most −140.31183525084741, even with free ordinary work, holding, and routing.

## Scope and overlap

Canonical `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, changed `p104-side-correction` scope. The exact #7244 scientific head `4156504fa39efb51c550d218a9b94fe69dbce8f6` and live head `215f67247f395c0e15f5ea3980f6a3e4aed155af` share science tree `f201bc8b5d1402ca40e7aa419269a58b7724798d`. The exact #7113 caller is `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. Exact bytes and all-column contract citations are included. [#7243](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7243) bounds paid chart-split capacity on #7161. [#7245](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7245) concerns fixed whole-output pooling within a coset. Here the targets are in distinct cosets and the source is one exact projective row on #7244. The separate navigation prerequisite reuses the already verified CI documentation commit.

## Replay

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions:

    python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-finite-monomial-decoder-bound

Clean local replay passed. The wrapper authenticates and regenerates the full stock, one-arm availability and tensor receipts, checks two independent scientific audits, and reconstructs all 110,553 paid positions and 22,461 productive targets. The finite control gives a width-one signed success that fails at tensor multiplicity three. All 34 committed-byte, mode and source-history checks and six navigation tests pass. The base controls cover cap-one, corrupt source, duplicate key and forged independent source. Hosted checks are pending. No changed supplier, tape or all-size multiplier replay ran.

A new paid child on multiple independent inputs, changed scalar chronology or an arm count growing with multiplicity changes the contract. Price the complete compatible stock and actual routing, ownership, restoration, precision and tape costs before a prototype.
